Bundled by tools/build.mjs. All code is served from this machine; nothing is fetched from a CDN.

preact@11.2.0 — MIT
htm@3.1.1 — Apache-2.0
dompurify@3.4.17 — (MPL-2.0 OR Apache-2.0)
marked@17.0.6 — MIT
@tiptap/core@3.33.0 — MIT
@tiptap/pm@3.33.0 — MIT
Fonts: Archivo, Literata (SIL Open Font License 1.1). Icons: Lucide (ISC).

Also bundled (copied as released, not rebuilt):
pdfjs-dist@4.10.38 (PDF.js, Mozilla) — Apache-2.0. app/static/vendor/pdfjs/ (licence in LICENSE there). Shows PDFs in the reader; no WebAssembly, no eval, and it fetches nothing from outside this server.
  Its standard_fonts/ folder carries the Foxit fonts (BSD-style, LICENSE_FOXIT) and Liberation Sans (SIL OFL 1.1, LICENSE_LIBERATION).
Carlito (Google, metric-compatible with Calibri) — SIL Open Font License 1.1. app/static/fonts/carlito-*.woff2 (licence in LICENSE-carlito.txt). Lets slides wrap text the way PowerPoint does.
